rules: A row exists only if the fixture (date, both teams, competition) was read on the competition's own official domain or its official league API during this session.
A field the official page did not state is left blank and listed in flagged.json. Nothing is inferred, converted or filled from memory.
Times are reproduced exactly as the official page printed them; the timezone is only recorded where the page itself states it.
